    try {
        // 获取请求参数
        var sysId = request.queryParams.sys_id || request.body.data.sys_id;
        
        // 调用您的Script Include
        var si = new x_1770592_easy_t_0.GenerateAssetRequestPDF();
        var result = si.generatePDF(sysId);
        
        // 处理响应
        if (result.startsWith('{')) {
            // 错误响应
            var error = JSON.parse(result);
            response.setStatus(500);
            response.setBody({
                status: 'error',
                message: error.message
            });
        } else {
            // PDF二进制响应
            response.setContentType('application/pdf');
            response.setHeader('Content-Disposition', 'attachment; filename="asset_request_' + sysId + '.pdf"');
            response.setBody(result);
        }
    } catch (e) {
        response.setStatus(500);
        response.setBody({
            status: 'error',
            message: e.message
        });
    }
})();]]></operation_script><operation_uri>/api/x_1770592_easy_t_0/assetrequestpdfgenerator/generate</operation_uri><produces>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</produces><produces_customized>false</produces_customized><relative_path>/generate</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>true</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>true</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description/><sys_class_name>sys_ws_operation</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-06-01 00:38:53</sys_created_on><sys_id>f0238ee2c37d22109d5afeac050131e0</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Generate PDF</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Easy to get" source="x_1770592_easy_t_0">73143024c37522109d5afeac0501313f</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Easy to get">73143024c37522109d5afeac0501313f</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ws_operation_f0238ee2c37d22109d5afeac050131e0</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-06-01 00:38:53</sys_updated_on><web_service_definition display_value="AssetRequestPDFGenerator">74a2c2aec33d22109d5afeac0501317a</web_service_definition><web_service_version/></sys_ws_operation></record_update>
